title: Uwutanga Ubwenge Budahera
intro: Umuntu yubahwa cane, azwi kubera ubukerebutsi bwiwe bwimbitse be n’impanuro ziwe z’ubwenge, yigeze gutanga impanuro zirengeye amayaruka. Amajambo yabo, yanditswe mu vyanditswe vyeranda, ayobora abantu ku giti cabo mu gukenguruka, mu kwihangana no mu kwigenza neza.
clues: Nahanuye umwana wanje ku vyaha bikomeye kuruta ibindi vyose: gufatanya na Allah.
Narigishije ivyerekeye uburemere bw’ibikorwa, mbere n’agaciro k’akabuto ka sinapi, n’ingene Allah azobizana.
Nashimikiye cane ku gukengurukira Allah no ku bavyeyi biwe, nkemera intambara zo kurera umwana.
Impanuro yanje yarimwo gushinga amasengesho, gutegeka ivyiza, kubuza ikibi, no kwihanganira umuntu yihanganye ivyo ashikira.
Igice kimwe muri Korowani citiriwe izina ryanje, kirimwo inyigisho zanje n’ivyigwa nasangiye.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
